library(shiny)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(lattice)
library(RCurl)
library(repmis)

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Diabetes Dataset"),  
  
  
  # Show a bar plot
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("d_outcome")
  )
)

# Define server logic required to draw a barplot
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  our_data <- source_data("https://github.com/Nickssingh/Test/raw/master/New%20Folder/diabetes")
  
  
  output$d_outcome <- renderPlot({
    barplot(table(our_data$Outcome))
  })
}

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
